page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-480GB-2xB200 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8570 processor with 48 physical cores and 48 vCPUs operating at 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, providing 10.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it integrates two NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs with a combined 384 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in multi-threaded and specialized workloads. The server achieves top-tier ratings in Passmark CPU score, CPU extended instructions, and physics simulations. Memory performance is highlighted by a top-tier uncached large-block read bandwidth of 385.14 GB/sec, alongside strong multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng. For AI workloads, the system demonstrates top-tier prompt processing speeds of 9,458.91 tokens/sec using a small 135M LLM model. Single-core performance and memory scores sit in the average tier.

Given the integration of dual Blackwell B200 GPUs and a high-density memory profile, this server represents a high-resource tier optimized for massive parallel processing. The lack of local storage requires external storage integration, which is a key architectural tradeoff. It is highly suited for large-scale AI and machine learning workloads, including LLM inference, deep learning training, complex physics simulations, and high-throughput database operations.
